MaxProof：使用生成验证器 RL 和群体级测试时间缩放来缩放数学证明MaxProof: Scaling Mathematical Proof with Generative-Verifier RL and Population-Level Test-Time Scaling

Jiacheng Chen MiniMax The Chinese University of Hong Kong Xinyu Zhang Fudan University Shunkai Zhang Peking University Yanmohan Wang MiniMax Tsinghua University Lin Li MiniMax Tiancheng Qin MiniMax Qin Wang MiniMax Zhengmao Zhu MiniMax Tianle Li MiniMax Jingyang Li MiniMax Zehan Li MiniMax Binyang Jiang MiniMax Jin Zhu MiniMax Han Ding MiniMax Fei Yu MiniMax Chenyu Du MiniMax Zijian Song MiniMax Jiayuan Song MiniMax Zhi Zhang MiniMax Yunan Huang MiniMax Weiyu Cheng MiniMax Pengyu Zhao MiniMax Yu Cheng The Chinese University of Hong Kong
摘要Abstract

我们呈现We present最大证明MaxProof，MiniMax-M3 系列中用于竞赛级数学证明的群体级测试时间缩放框架。 M3 首先使用专为低误报率而设计的深度防御生成验证器来训练三种面向证明的功能：证明生成、证明验证和批判条件证明修复。这些功能被合并到一个发布的 M3 模型中。在测试时，MaxProof 将模型视为生成器、验证器、精炼器和排名器，搜索候选证明群体，并通过锦标赛选择返回一个最终证明。通过 MaxProof 测试时间缩放，M3 模型达到, a population-level test-time scaling framework for competition-level mathematical proof in the MiniMax-M3 series. M3 first trains three proof-oriented capabilities—proof generation, proof verification, and critique-conditioned proof repair—using a defense-in-depth generative verifier engineered for low false-positive rate. These capabilities are merged into a single released M3 model. At test time, MaxProof treats the model as a generator, verifier, refiner, and ranker, searches over a population of candidate proofs, and returns one final proof through tournament selection. With MaxProof test-time scaling, the M3 model reachesIMO 2025 35/4235/42 on IMO 2025和and36/42 2026 年 USAMO36/42 on USAMO 2026，两项都超过了人类金牌门槛。, exceeding the human gold-medal threshold on both.

1. 简介1. Introduction

数学证明是对语言模型中可靠推理的高压压力测试。与开放式生成不同，证明必须满足一长串紧密耦合的约束，对对话中经常被忽视的挥手行为的容忍度非常低。这使得证明成为 IMO-Answerbench 和 IMO-ProofBench 等基准测试中研究的一般数学推理挑战的更尖锐版本Mathematical proof is a high-pressure stress test for reliable reasoning in language models. Unlike open-ended generation, a proof must satisfy a long, tightly coupled chain of constraints, with very low tolerance for the kind of hand-waving that often passes unnoticed in conversational chat. This makes proof a sharper version of the general mathematical-reasoning challenge studied in benchmarks such as IMO-Answerbench and IMO-ProofBench[imobench-google]。随着基础模型的发展，源源不断的系统推动了竞赛级证明的前沿：AlphaGeometry 表明神经符号系统无需人类演示即可解决奥林匹克几何问题. As base models have grown, a steady stream of systems has pushed the frontier of competition-level proof: AlphaGeometry showed that neural-symbolic systems can solve olympiad geometry problems without human demonstrations[trinh2024alphageometry];阿尔法证明; AlphaProof[alphaproof2024]将语言模型与 AlphaZero 式搜索相结合combined a language model with AlphaZero-style search[silver2018alphazero]在 IMO 2024 上取得银牌表现； Gemini Deep Thinking 和 OpenAI 前沿模型在 IMO 2025 上获得金牌表现to achieve silver-medal performance on IMO 2024; Gemini Deep Thinking and OpenAI’s frontier models reached gold-medal performance on IMO 2025[googledeepmind2025gemini]; DeepSeek-Math-V2 成为同一比赛中第一个开放重量的黄金级模型; DeepSeek-Math-V2 became the first open-weight gold-level model on the same contest[shao2025deepseekmathv2]; SU-01 和 NVIDIA Nemotron Cascade2 等较小的开放模型证明，竞赛级证明可以专门用于次前沿规模; smaller open models such as SU-01 and NVIDIA Nemotron Cascade2 demonstrated that competition-level proof can be specialized for at sub-frontier scale[li2026achieving, cascade2]; GPT-5.5 最近解决了人类数学家多年来未能解决的长期悬而未决的问题; and GPT-5.5 recently solved long-standing open problems that had eluded human mathematicians for years[gpt55open]。本文是来自同一边界 M3 一侧的报告。. This paper is a report from the M3 side of that same frontier.

M3 版本是通用模型，但竞赛级证明所施加的要求比大多数其他任务所施加的要求更为尖锐。在 IMO 2025 和 USAMO 2026 上将 M3 推向金牌线迫使我们面临三个独立的设计问题，我们将其视为一系列原子能力：The M3 release is a general-purpose model, but the requirements imposed by competition-level proof are sharper than the requirements imposed by most other tasks. Pushing M3 past the gold-medal line on both IMO 2025 and USAMO 2026 forced three separate design questions, which we treat as a sequence of atomic capabilities:

  1. 1.

    证明生成。Proof generation.考虑到竞争问题，模型能否产生至少有时接近正确证明的候选证明？这是规范的Given a competition problem, can the model produce a candidate proof that is at least sometimes close to a correct one? This is the canonical一击最佳@Kone-shot best@K问题。更广泛的推理模型文献表明，自我改进、数学专业后训练和大规模强化学习可以极大地改变模型的推理行为question. The broader reasoning-model literature has shown that self-improvement, math-specialized post-training, and large-scale RL can substantially change a model’s reasoning behavior[zelikman2022star, shao2024deepseekmath, yang2024qwen25math, r1, kimi2025k15]。 M2 系列已经表明，具有来自执行或单元测试反馈的奖励的长期强化学习可以极大地推动基础模型；为了证明这一点，等效信号必须来自生成验证器，这会带来围绕奖励噪声、误报和奖励黑客的更困难的问题。. The M2 series had already shown that long-horizon RL with a reward derived from execution or unit-test feedback can push a base model substantially; for proof, the equivalent signal has to come from a generative verifier, and that introduces a much harder class of issues around reward noise, false positives, and reward hacking.

  2. 2.

    证明验证。Proof verification.模型能否可靠地指向Can the model reliably point to哪里where给定的证明是错误的，并解释a given proof is wrong, and explain为什么why？这是第二个原子能力：能够? This is the second atomic capability: the ability to批评critique一个证明。它支持我们在第二部分中描述的自检、纠错和总体水平搜索，并且与数学推理中的验证者和过程监督工作密切相关a proof. It underwrites self-checking, error correction, and the population-level search that we describe in Part II, and is closely related to verifier and process-supervision work in mathematical reasoning[cobbe2021gsm8k, lightman2023verify]。重要的是，这与“分配 0-7 分”的目标不同——它需要定位和描述错误，而不是对错误进行排名。. Importantly, this is a different objective from “assign a 0–7 score”—it requires localizing and describing errors, not ranking them.

  3. 3.

    证明细化。Proof refinement.给定有缺陷的证明和批评，该模型能否产生正确的版本？这是第三个原子能力：能够Given a flawed proof together with a critique, can the model produce a corrected version? This is the third atomic capability: the ability to修复fix一个证明。它在结构上与一次性生成不同——模型必须读取现有的参数，保留其正确的部分，并修补目标缺陷。这更接近于修复而不是生成，并且与语言模型中迭代自我反馈和修订的最新工作相关a proof. It is structurally different from one-shot generation—the model has to read the existing argument, preserve its correct parts, and patch the targeted defects. This is closer to repair than to generation, and connects to recent work on iterative self-feedback and revision in language models[madaan2023selfrefine, shinn2023reflexion].

在 M3 发布管道中，我们通过一系列专业培训阶段构建这三种功能：In the M3 release pipeline, we build these three capabilities through a chain of specialist training stages: a证明专家Proof Expert由长视野强化学习在深度防御生成验证器下进行训练，trained by long-horizon RL under a defense-in-depth generative verifier, a验证专家Verifier Expert与同一验证者保持一致，以明确的错误查找为主要目标，并且aligned to the same verifier with explicit error finding as the primary objective, and a修复专家Fixer Expert学习修复验证者标记的证明（第that learns to repair proofs flagged by the verifier (Section2–4）。然后，这些功能将合并到最终的 M3 模型中，这是交付给用户的单一模型。). These capabilities are then merged into the final M3 model, which is the single model that ships to users.

本文的后半部分介绍了The second half of the paper presents最大证明MaxProof（节(Section5）作为与模型无关的群体水平测试时间缩放框架。 MaxProof仅假设生成器、验证器、精炼器和排序器接口；这些接口可以由单独的模型提供服务，但在 M3 版本中，它们在不同的提示下都由相同的合并模型提供服务。该框架基于最近在自我一致性、树结构审议、验证和细化管道以及扩展推理时间计算方面的工作，通过搜索候选证明群体、在许多候选者之间分摊验证者噪声并通过成对锦标赛自选最终确定答案，将 best@K 转换为更稳定的 pass@1) as a model-agnostic population-level test-time scaling framework. MaxProof only assumes generator, verifier, refiner, and ranker interfaces; these interfaces can be served by separate models, but in the M3 release they are all served by the same merged model under different prompts. The framework converts best@K into a more stable pass@1 by searching over a population of candidate proofs, amortizing verifier noise across many candidates, and finalizing the answer through a pairwise tournament self-pick, building on recent work on self-consistency, tree-structured deliberation, verification-and-refinement pipelines, and scaling inference-time compute[wang2023selfconsistency, yao2023tree, snell2024scaling, brown2024large, wu2024empirical, huang2025winning].

贡献。Contributions.具体而言，本报告做出以下贡献。Concretely, this report makes the following contributions.

  • •

    我们描述了一个四层生成验证器管道（坏情况过滤、解决方案标准化、多评判并行评分和悲观最小聚合）及其工程原理：强化学习时间验证器的中心设计目标不是静态基准上的最大精度，而是长期运行训练流上的最小误报率。We describe a four-layer generative-verifier pipeline (bad-case filtering, solution normalization, multi-judge parallel scoring, and pessimistic min aggregation) and the engineering rationale for it: the central design goal of an RL-time verifier is not maximum accuracy on a static benchmark, but minimum false-positive rate on a long-running training stream.

  • •

    我们分享了 M2 周期中的惨痛教训：使用单评判标准验证器进行长期 RL 运行很可能会导致奖励黑客平台，而不是真正的能力增益。我们记录了我们观察到的四种典型的黑客模式（长度偏差、格式黑客、语义快捷方式、法官特定偏好），并解释了 M3 验证器设计是如何根据使每种模式更难被利用的需要而形成的。We share the bitter lesson learned in the M2 cycle: a long RL run with a single-judge rubric verifier will, with high probability, end in a reward-hacking plateau, not in real capability gains. We document the four canonical hacking patterns we observed (length bias, format hacking, semantic shortcut, judge-specific preference) and explain how the M3 verifier design is shaped by the need to make each of them substantially harder to exploit.

  • •

    我们将 MaxProof 呈现为具有受进化启发的搜索循环的群体级测试时间扩展框架，并介绍了使其在实践中发挥作用的设计选择：保守的基于验证者的适应度、多样化的父代选择、平衡利用和探索的双重 PATCH/REWRITE 细化、成对锦标赛最终选择以及群体级提前停止以减少剩余验证者误报。We present MaxProof as a population-level test-time scaling framework with an evolution-inspired search loop, and walk through the design choices that make it work in practice: conservative verifier-based fitness, diverse parent selection, dual PATCH/REWRITE refinement to balance exploitation and exploration, a pairwise tournament final selection, and a population-level early stop to reduce residual verifier false positives.

  • •

    我们报告独立基准性能和测试时间扩展结果。在 IMOProofBench 和 IMOAnswerBench 上，M3 缩小了与前沿闭源模型的差距。借助 MaxProof，相同的 M3 模型在 IMO 2025 上达到 35/42，在 USAMO 2026 上达到 36/42。我们还共享总体中每个问题的搜索动态，我们认为这比单独的最终自选提供了更丰富的信息诊断。We report both standalone benchmark performance and test-time scaling results. On IMOProofBench and IMOAnswerBench, M3 narrows the gap to frontier closed-source models. With MaxProof, the same M3 model reaches 35/42 on IMO 2025 and 36/42 on USAMO 2026. We also share the per-problem search dynamics over the population, which we believe to be a more informative diagnostic than the final self-pick alone.

大纲。Outline.本文的其余部分组织如下。第一部分介绍了基本模型原子功能：部分The remainder of the paper is organized as follows. Part I covers the base-model atomic capabilities: Section2描述 Proof Expert，包括验证者管道、RL 训练配方和 M2 周期的奖励黑客案例研究；部分describes the Proof Expert, including the verifier pipeline, the RL training recipe, and the M2 cycle’s reward-hacking case study; Section3描述验证器专家；部分describes the Verifier Expert; Section4描述 Fixer Expert。第二部分涵盖测试时间缩放：部分describes the Fixer Expert. Part II covers test-time scaling: Section5提出了 MaxProof 框架。第三部分涵盖评估：部分presents the MaxProof framework. Part III covers evaluation: Section6报告了 IMO 2025 和 USAMO 2026 上的独立基准性能和 MaxProof 的额外收益，以及部分reports standalone benchmark performance and the additional gains from MaxProof on IMO 2025 and USAMO 2026, and Section7结论是。附录中提供了每个问题的细分和提示模板。concludes. Per-problem breakdowns and prompt templates are provided in the appendix.

2. 证明专家：纵深防御验证器下的长视野强化学习2. Proof Expert: Long-Horizon RL under a Defense-in-Depth Verifier

我们需要的第一个原子能力是The first atomic capability we need is the ability to生成generate至少偶尔接近正确的证明。对于已经表现出竞争级别的 best@K 行为的模型，增强该能力的自然途径是长期强化学习，并带有对候选证明进行评分的奖励信号，遵循推理模型的强化学习和可验证奖励工作的更广泛路线a proof that is at least occasionally close to correct. For a model that already exhibits competition-level best@K behavior, the natural route to sharpening that capability is long-horizon RL with a reward signal that scores candidate proofs, following the broader line of RL and RL-with-verifiable-reward work for reasoning models[lambert2024tulu, r1, kimi2025k15, su2025crossing, wen2025reinforcement, kimiteam2026kimik2openagentic, glm5team2026glm5vibecodingagentic]。然而，为了证明，没有可执行的基本事实可供调用——奖励必须来自生成验证者，这引入了比代码或单元测试任务上基于结果的强化学习更难的问题。本节介绍我们如何构建 Proof Expert、支持它的验证器管道，以及塑造最终设计的早期迭代的故障模式。. For proof, however, there is no executable ground truth to call—the reward has to come from a generative verifier, and this introduces a much harder class of issues than outcome-based RL on code or unit-test tasks. This section describes how we built the Proof Expert, the verifier pipeline that backs it, and the failure modes of an earlier iteration that shaped the final design.

2.1. 培训渠道概述2.1. Training Pipeline Overview

证明专家围绕一个中心对象进行训练：一个冻结的生成验证器，它将候选证明转化为 RL 奖励。对于每个竞争问题，推出策略都会对一组长格式候选证明进行采样。然后，每个证明都会传递给验证者，验证者不仅检查最终答案，还检查最终结果。它读取参数，将其与从参考解决方案派生的评分标准进行比较，识别缺失或无效的步骤，并返回文本评估和标量分数The Proof Expert is trained around a single central object: a frozen generative verifier that turns a candidate proof into an RL reward. For each competition problem, the rollout policy samples a group of long-form candidate proofs. Each proof is then passed to the verifier, which does not merely check for a final answer; it reads the argument, compares it against a rubric derived from a reference solution, identifies missing or invalid steps, and returns both a textual assessment and a scalar score in[0,7][0,7]。我们使用该标量作为整个证明的轨迹级奖励，并使用 GRPO 的变体更新策略. We use that scalar as the trajectory-level reward for the entire proof, and update the policy with a variant of GRPO[shao2024deepseekmath]适应 M 系列 CISPO 物镜adapted to the M-series CISPO objective[minimax2025m1, minimax2025m2].

这种选择使得证明强化学习在代码、工具使用或简答数学方面不同于强化学习。在代码任务中，奖励通常可以基于执行：程序要么通过单元测试，要么未通过This choice is what makes proof RL different from RL on code, tool use, or short-answer math. In code tasks, the reward can often be grounded in execution: a program either passes unit tests or it does not[chen2021humaneval, jimenez2024swebench]。在证明任务中，正确性对象是自然语言数学论证，因此奖励模型本身必须对证明进行推理. In proof tasks, the correctness object is a natural-language mathematical argument, so the reward model must itself reason about the proof[lightman2023verify, shao2025deepseekmathv2]。因此，验证器不是训练后调用的辅助评估器；它是政策接收学习信号的环境。如果验证者奖励一个有缺陷但有说服力的论点，强化学习就会放大这个缺陷；这与人工智能安全和奖励建模工作中研究的基本奖励游戏风险相同. The verifier is therefore not an auxiliary evaluator that is called after training; it is the environment from which the policy receives learning signal. If the verifier rewards a flawed but persuasive argument, RL will amplify that flaw; this is the same basic reward-gaming risk studied in AI safety and reward-modeling work[amodei2016concrete, skalse2022defining]。如果验证者的噪音太大，群体相对优势就会变成噪音。如果验证者对格式过于敏感，策略将学习格式而不是数学。. If the verifier is overly noisy, group-relative advantages collapse into noise. If the verifier is too sensitive to formatting, the policy will learn the format instead of the mathematics.

因此，训练管道被组织为具有三个耦合组件的闭环。首先，数据管道提供了当前模型具有重要空间的问题，因此一组样本既包含失败又包含部分成功。其次，生成验证器使用第 1 节中描述的深度防御管道将这些样本转换为保守的标量奖励The training pipeline is consequently organized as a closed loop with three coupled components. First, the data pipeline supplies problems for which the current model has non-trivial headroom, so that a group of samples contains both failures and partial successes. Second, the generative verifier converts those samples into conservative scalar rewards, using the defense-in-depth pipeline described in Section2.2。第三，CISPO 仅从验证者分数显示有意义的质量梯度的组更新策略。本节的其余部分遵循相同的依赖顺序：我们首先描述验证者，因为它定义了奖励；然后是强化学习目标，因为它消耗了奖励；最后是数据构建和 M2 奖励黑客课程，因为它们解释了为什么验证者必须保守而不仅仅是在静态基准上准确。. Third, CISPO updates the policy only from groups whose verifier scores expose a meaningful quality gradient. The rest of this section follows that same dependency order: we first describe the verifier, because it defines the reward; then the RL objective, because it consumes that reward; and finally the data construction and the M2 reward-hacking lesson, because they explain why the verifier has to be conservative rather than merely accurate on a static benchmark.

2.2. 纵深防御验证器2.2. Defense-in-Depth Verifier

验证器是整个Proof Expert的基石。如果验证者不可靠，那么每个下游选择——强化学习算法、数据混合、迭代长度、提前停止策略——都会在受污染的信号上运行。 M2 周期的核心教训（部分The verifier is the cornerstone of the entire Proof Expert. If the verifier is unreliable, every downstream choice—the RL algorithm, the data mix, the iteration length, the early-stop policy—is operating on contaminated signal. A central lesson from the M2 cycle (Section2.5）的问题是，在长视野强化学习下，即使是在静态基准上看起来合理的验证者也可能会陷入嘈杂或可破解的状态。因此，我们将 M3 验证器构建为四层防御，每一层都旨在抑制特定的故障模式。四层依次运行；前两个是护栏，最后两个产生分数。) is that under long-horizon RL, even a verifier that looks reasonable on a static benchmark can drift into a noisy or hackable regime. We therefore structure the M3 verifier as a four-layer defense, with each layer designed to suppress a specific failure mode. The four layers run in sequence; the first two are guardrails, the last two produce the score.

该设计有意保守。误报可以成为策略学习重现的训练目标，而误报通常只会丢弃众多候选者中的一个。因此，管道将其复杂性用于抑制高分无效证明，而不是最大化静态基准一致性。The design is intentionally conservative. A false positive can become a training target that the policy learns to reproduce, while a false negative usually only discards one candidate among many. The pipeline therefore spends its complexity on suppressing high-scoring invalid proofs rather than on maximizing static benchmark agreement.

四层如图所示The four layers are illustrated in Figure4，从左到右读：首先根据坏情况规则检查候选证明，然后标准化，然后由三位法官评分，最后通过悲观最小聚合减少为单个标量。, which reads left to right: a candidate proof is first checked against the bad-case rules, then normalized, then scored by the three judges, and finally reduced to a single scalar through pessimistic min aggregation.

2.3. RL 算法：带有标准阈值滤波器的 CISPO2.3. RL Algorithm: CISPO with std-Threshold Filter

证明专家接受过 CISPO 培训The Proof Expert is trained with CISPO[minimax2025m1]，一个非策略 REINFORCE 风格的目标，它会削减重要性采样权重而不是替代损失。这将其置于与 PPO 相同的裁剪策略梯度方法系列中，同时更改裁剪位置以更好地保留长响应中的令牌级别梯度, an off-policy REINFORCE-style objective that clips the importance-sampling weight rather than the surrogate loss. This places it in the same family of clipped policy-gradient methods as PPO, while changing the clipping location to better preserve token-level gradients in long responses[schulman2017proximal]。对于一个问题. 哪里wheresg⁡(⋅)\operatorname{sg}(\cdot)表示停止梯度。剪裁比率用作有界标量权重，但梯度仍然流经每个标记的对数概率项。这对于长证明很重要：与 PPO 式的裁剪不同，比率离开信任范围的令牌会被降低权重，而不是完全从梯度中删除。denotes stop-gradient. The clipped ratio is used as a bounded scalar weight, but gradients still flow through the log-probability term for every token. This is important for long proofs: unlike PPO-style clipping, a token whose ratio leaves the trust range is down-weighted rather than removed from the gradient altogether.

我们将证明级验证者分数视为轨迹奖励。这避免了为数学论证发明嘈杂的步骤级标签，并且它给出了比二进制正确/不正确结果更密集的信号。这是故意比代理过程监督方法更加保守，代理方法在没有人工步骤标签的情况下推断中间奖励We treat the proof-level verifier score as the trajectory reward. This avoids inventing noisy step-level labels for mathematical arguments, and it gives a denser signal than a binary correct/incorrect outcome. This is deliberately more conservative than process-supervision-by-proxy approaches that infer intermediate rewards without human step labels[lightman2023verify, chen2024alphamath]。代价是，当验证者无法有意义地将同一组中的候选者分开时，组相对优势就变得不可靠。. The tradeoff is that group-relative advantages become unreliable when the verifier cannot meaningfully separate candidates in the same group.

为了抑制这种故障模式，我们应用了To suppress that failure mode, we apply a组级标准阈值过滤器group-level std-threshold filter。让. Letτstd\tau_{\mathrm{std}}是一个小的正阈值。仅当以下情况时，转出组才会参与更新：be a small positive threshold. A rollout group contributes to the update only if

σR>τstd.\sigma_{R}>\tau_{\mathrm{std}}. (4)

等效地，有效目标是Equivalently, the effective objective is

𝒥Proof​(θ)=𝔼​[𝟏​{σR>τstd}​𝒥CISPO​(θ;p,y1:G)].\mathcal{J}_{\mathrm{Proof}}(\theta)=\mathbb{E}\left[\mathbf{1}\{\sigma_{R}>\tau_{\mathrm{std}}\}\,\mathcal{J}_{\mathrm{CISPO}}(\theta;p,y_{1:G})\right]. (5)

该过滤器是特意在组级别而不是候选者级别应用的。如果所有候选者都收到几乎相同的验证者分数，则诱导排序更有可能是噪声而不是学习信号；过滤整个组可以防止更新放大任意分数差异。具有重要奖励方差的组被保留，因此策略仍然从验证者暴露有意义的质量梯度的提示中学习。The filter is deliberately applied at the group level rather than the candidate level. If all candidates receive nearly identical verifier scores, the induced ordering is more likely to be noise than learning signal; filtering the entire group prevents the update from amplifying arbitrary score differences. Groups with non-trivial reward variance are kept, so the policy still learns from prompts where the verifier exposes a meaningful quality gradient.

2.4. 数据：领域和技巧平衡2.4. Data: Domain and Trick Balance

训练数据来自公共竞赛来源，主要是竞赛式问题陈述和人工编写的参考解决方案，遵循在训练后数学推理中更广泛地使用竞赛数学和证明语料库Training data is drawn from public competition sources, primarily competition-style problem statements with human-written reference solutions, following the broader use of competition-math and proof corpora in mathematical-reasoning post-training[li2024numinamath, he2025deepmath, dekoninck2025opc]。每个问题都用一个小的结构化模式进行注释：参考解决方案（用于导出评分方案）、问题的数学领域以及所需的特定解决技巧或技术。评分方案是通过强大的模型在几次提示中针对一小部分人工注释的样本生成的。我们删除了本报告中使用的保留评估源，包括 IMO 2025、USAMO 2026、IMOProofBench 和 IMOAnswerBench，并在训练前对其问题陈述应用近乎重复的过滤。在将数据馈送到 RL 循环之前运行三个额外的预处理步骤：. Each problem is annotated with a small structured schema: the reference solution (used to derive a grading scheme), the problem’s mathematical domain, and the specific solving trick or technique required. The grading scheme is generated with a strong model in a few-shot prompt against a small set of human-annotated exemplars. We remove the held-out evaluation sources used in this report, including IMO 2025, USAMO 2026, IMOProofBench, and IMOAnswerBench, and apply near-duplicate filtering against their problem statements before training. Three additional pre-processing steps run before the data is fed to the RL loop:

  • •

    过滤困难。Difficulty filtering.我们使用上一代 M2.7 模型作为基线，并消除 M2.7 可靠解决的问题，因为它们会消耗训练预算而不产生有用的学习信号。We use the previous-generation M2.7 model as a baseline and remove problems that M2.7 solves reliably, because they would consume training budget without producing useful learning signal.

  • •

    域平衡。Domain balancing.我们平衡代数、组合学、几何和数论之间的域分布，以便没有任何一个数学分支主导梯度。We balance the domain distribution across algebra, combinatorics, geometry, and number theory so that no single mathematical branch dominates the gradient.

  • •

    特技频率控制。Trick-frequency control.我们平滑高频技巧的长尾，同时保留表征竞争分布的真实低频尾部。We smooth the long tail of high-frequency tricks while preserving the real low-frequency tail that characterizes competition distributions.

图Figure5显示经过这些过滤器和平衡步骤后得到的训练集分布。shows the resulting training-set distribution after these filters and balancing steps.

我们的目标不是一个统一的数据集（统一的混合会消除有用的结构信息），而是一个没有单一域或技巧主导梯度的数据集。The objective is not a uniform dataset—a uniform mix would erase useful structural information—but a dataset in which no single domain or trick dominates the gradient.

2.5. M2 周期：奖励黑客案例研究2.5. M2 Cycle: A Reward-Hacking Case Study

M2 周期使用单标题生成验证器和相对简单的聚合进行了长期 Proof RL 实验。在前几百次迭代中，训练指标看起来很健康，但对模型输出的更详细分析表明，该策略已经学习了许多规范的奖励黑客模式。最一致的四个如下。The M2 cycle ran a long-horizon Proof RL experiment with a single-rubric generative verifier and a relatively simple aggregation. The training metrics looked healthy for the first several hundred iterations, but a more detailed analysis of the model’s outputs revealed that the policy had learned a number of canonical reward-hacking patterns. The four most consistent ones were the following.

  1. 1.

    长度偏差。Length bias.随着训练的进行，可见的证明长度大致增长了As training progressed, the visible proof length grew by roughly3×3\times（来自(from∼\sim3.5K 至3.5K to∼\sim10K字符），隐藏思维长度增长得更快。长证明更容易与标题关键词保持一致，并且使单判断验证者更难检测到挥手行为。10K characters), and the hidden thinking length grew even faster. Long proofs are easier to align with rubric keywords, and they make it harder for a single-judge verifier to detect hand-waving.

  2. 2.

    格式化黑客。Format hacking.该政策集中于一小组表面模板：固定的“步骤”The policy converged on a small set of surface templates: a fixed “StepNN”标题，“验证”部分，“最终答案”块，以及“我们被给予......”形式的开场白。到运行结束时，超过 80% 的政策输出都遵循此模板，即使对于该模板没有数学意义的问题也是如此。” header, a “Verification” section, a “Final Answer” block, and an opener of the form “We are given…”. By the end of the run, more than 80% of the policy’s outputs followed this template, even on problems for which the template made no mathematical sense.

  3. 3.

    语义捷径。Semantic shortcut.该政策开始在论证的困难部分所在的确切位置插入诸如“可以显示”或“简化后”等捷径。这些捷径很少被单评判标准验证者发现，因为周围的文本是正确的，并且标准的关键词也存在。The policy began to insert shortcuts such as “it can be shown” or “after simplification” at the exact points where the hard parts of the argument would otherwise have been. These shortcuts were rarely caught by a single-judge rubric verifier, because the surrounding text was correct and the rubric’s keywords were present.

  4. 4.

    法官特定的偏好。Judge-specific preference.该政策了解了单个法官的特殊偏好——它奖励的措辞、它宽容的错误、它喜欢的格式。这是最有害的模式，因为它可以使验证者分数大幅提高，而底层证明质量却保持不变甚至下降。The policy learned the idiosyncratic preferences of the single judge—phrasings it rewarded, errors it was lenient about, formats it preferred. This is the most pernicious pattern, because it can produce large gains in the verifier score while the underlying proof quality stays flat or even regresses.

这四种模式加在一起，构成了教科书式的奖励黑客失败模式：过于包容的验证者和足够耐心发现包容的政策These four patterns, taken together, constitute a textbook reward-hacking failure mode: a verifier that is too accommodating and a policy that is patient enough to discover the accommodation[amodei2016concrete, skalse2022defining]。 M3 验证器管道是由本课程直接塑造的。坏情况过滤器（第 1 层）和解决方案标准化器（第 2 层）直接针对格式黑客和判断偏好模式；多评委并行评分（第3层）针对语义捷径模式；悲观最小聚合（第 4 层）旨在限制最坏情况下的假阳性率，即使以额外的假阴性为代价。. The M3 verifier pipeline is shaped directly by this lesson. The bad-case filter (Layer 1) and the solution normalizer (Layer 2) are aimed squarely at the format-hacking and judge-preference patterns; the multi-judge parallel scoring (Layer 3) is aimed at the semantic-shortcut pattern; the pessimistic min aggregation (Layer 4) is aimed at limiting the worst-case false-positive rate, even at the cost of additional false negatives.

图Figure6显示了 M2 奖励黑客检测仪表板的快照，我们构建该仪表板是为了在训练期间监控所有四种模式。四个小组报告（1）在用于培训的同一法官下的私人评估集的分数，（2）可见和思考长度趋势，（3）结构模板（步骤标题，验证部分，最终答案部分）在政策输出中出现的比率，以及（4）两种主要开放模式（“证明/解决......”与“我们被给予......”）出现的比率。该图与上面的分析一致：训练得分（左上）上升，但可见长度几乎增加了三倍，结构模板率收敛到 70-80%，开场分布几乎完全翻转。shows a snapshot of the M2 reward-hacking detection dashboard, which we built to monitor all four patterns during training. The four panels report (1) the score on a private evaluation set under the same judge used for training, (2) the visible- and thinking-length trend, (3) the rate at which structural templates (step headers, verification section, final-answer section) appear in the policy’s outputs, and (4) the rate at which the two dominant opening patterns (“To prove / To solve…” vs. “We are given…”) appear. The picture is consistent with the analysis above: the training score (top left) rises, but the visible length nearly triples, the structural-template rate converges to 70–80%, and the opener distribution flips almost completely.

M2 周期的核心教训是，静态基准评估本身无法区分真正的能力增益和奖励黑客增益。监控仪表板的开发正是为了使这种区别显而易见。一个小组说“分数上升”是错误的证据单位；正确的证据单位是独立信号组合在一起的向量。这就是 M3 验证器旨在支持的工程实践：四层管道不是单一的质量条，而是针对四种不同故障模式的协调防护栏，而单判断验证器无法同时抑制这些故障模式。The M2 cycle’s central lesson is that a static benchmark evaluation cannot, on its own, distinguish a real capability gain from a reward-hacking gain. The monitoring dashboard was developed precisely to make this distinction visible. A single panel that says “score went up” is the wrong unit of evidence; the right unit of evidence is a vector of independent signals, taken together. This is the engineering practice that the M3 verifier is designed to support: the four-layer pipeline is not a single quality bar, it is a coordinated set of guardrails against four distinct failure modes that a single-judge verifier cannot simultaneously suppress.

3. Verifier Expert：对齐错误查找3. Verifier Expert: Aligned Error Finding

一个可靠的批评家，从真正的意义上来说，是一个可靠的推理者的一半。我们需要的第二个原子能力是A reliable critic is, in a real sense, half of a reliable reasoner. The second atomic capability we need is the ability to法官judge证明：给定一个候选人，指出任何错误的位置，描述它们的问题所在，并给出明确的结论。多次证明，当学习验证者的判断用于选择、批评或训练信号时，他们可以提高数学推理能力a proof: given a candidate, point to the locations of any errors, describe what is wrong with them, and assign a categorical verdict. Learned verifiers have repeatedly been shown to improve mathematical reasoning when their judgments are used for selection, critique, or training signal[cobbe2021gsm8k, lightman2023verify, chen2025xverify]。证明专家的验证者（部分. The Proof Expert’s verifier (Section2.2）由外部模型实现，该模型迭代速度快，但在 RL 循环内调用成本昂贵。 M3 循环进一步将验证者的行为提炼成单个 M3 模型，我们称之为) is implemented by an external model, which is fast to iterate on but expensive to call inside an RL loop. The M3 cycle takes the further step of distilling the verifier’s behavior into a single M3 model, which we call the验证专家Verifier Expert。 Verifier Expert 被合并到最终的 M3 版本中，以便任何需要验证证明的下游代理或工具都可以直接调用合并的模型，而无需支付外部验证者的延迟成本。. The Verifier Expert is merged into the final M3 release, so that any downstream agent or tool that needs to verify a proof can call the merged model directly without paying the external-verifier latency cost.

3.1. 任务制定：错误查找节拍分数预测3.1. Task Formulation: Error Finding Beats Score Prediction

模型证明验证最明显的方法是作为 0-7 回归，匹配 MathArenaThe most obvious way to model proof verification is as a 0–7 regression, matching the MathArena[matharena2025]评估时使用的评分方案。我们刻意避免这种表述。回归目标是通过学习候选文本和分数之间的表面相关性的模型来满足的——它不需要知道scoring scheme used at evaluation time. We deliberately avoid this formulation. A regression objective is satisfied by a model that learns the surface correlation between the candidate’s text and a score—it does not need to know哪里where候选人错了，或者the candidate is wrong, or为什么why，以降低其损失。早期基于验证者的数学推理方法已经表明学习验证可以改善解决方案选择, to drive its loss down. Earlier verifier-based approaches to mathematical reasoning already showed that learned verification can improve solution selection[cobbe2021gsm8k];过程级监督; process-level supervision[lightman2023verify]进一步表明，定位错误而不是预测总分数会导致更可靠的验证者。我们通过要求显式错误枚举来进一步推动这个想法。further shows that localizing errors rather than predicting aggregate scores leads to more reliable verifiers. We push this idea further by requiring explicit error enumeration.

3.2. 训练数据：重用证明专家的验证器3.2. Training Data: Reusing the Proof Expert’s Verifier

Verifier Expert 的训练数据不是从头开始收集的。它是从证明专家自己的训练中几乎免费获得的。证明专家的验证者（部分The Verifier Expert’s training data is not collected from scratch. It is harvested, almost for free, from the Proof Expert’s own training run. The Proof Expert’s verifier (Section2.2）已经为其评分的每个候选生成了一个结构化输出，并且四层管道保证了结构化输出与验证器专家被要求生成的形状相同。对于每个候选人，我们保留与实现悲观最小分数的法官相关的批评和判决，因此文本监督和标量奖励指向相同的失败模式。因此，证明专家训练运行的聚合会产生一个包含（问题、候选、分析、错误、判决）元组的大型数据集，所有这些数据集都是由我们最终希望验证专家模仿的验证者生成的。) already produces a structured output for every candidate it scores, and the four-layer pipeline guarantees that the structured output is the same shape as what the Verifier Expert is asked to produce. For each candidate, we keep the critique and verdict associated with the judge that realizes the pessimistic-min score, so the textual supervision and scalar reward point to the same failure mode. The aggregate over the Proof Expert’s training run therefore yields a large dataset of (problem, candidate, analysis, errors, verdict) tuples, all of them generated by the very verifier that we eventually want the Verifier Expert to imitate.

两种设计选择使这种重用成为可能。首先，对齐目标是Two design choices make this reuse possible. First, the alignment target is the悲观最小教师信号pessimistic-min teacher signal——判决和批评与证明专家实际训练的分数相结合——而不是随机选择的法官的输出。这保证了验证专家学习与证明专家的 RL 信号编码相同的正确性概念；两位专家在什么才是好的证明上不能意见不一致。其次，数据按提示（而不是候选）分割成训练/验证/测试集，以防止证明专家的训练分布泄漏。—the verdict and critique paired with the score that the Proof Expert actually trains on—not the output of a randomly chosen judge. This guarantees that the Verifier Expert learns the same notion of correctness that the Proof Expert’s RL signal encodes; the two experts cannot drift out of sync on what counts as a good proof. Second, the data is split by prompt (not by candidate) into train/validation/test sets, to prevent leakage from the Proof Expert’s training distribution.

收获的数据集主要由The harvested dataset is dominated by the无错误no_errors和and有错误has_errors类（合计约 65%）。中级班（classes (roughly 65% combined). The intermediate classes (小差距minor_gaps, 根本上是错误的fundamentally_wrong）在证明专家的训练分布中故意代表性不足，并且在收获的数据中也代表性不足。我们重新平衡四个类别，以避免让验证专家崩溃到两个极端。) are deliberately under-represented in the Proof Expert’s training distribution, and they are also under-represented in the harvested data. We rebalance the four classes to avoid letting the Verifier Expert collapse to the two extremes.

3.3. 奖励设计3.3. Reward Design

验证器专家接受复合奖励的训练，该奖励反映了其输出的结构：The Verifier Expert is trained with a composite reward that mirrors the structure of its output:

R=0.7⋅Rerror+0.3⋅Rverdict,R=0.7\cdot R_{\text{error}}+0.3\cdot R_{\text{verdict}}, (6)

哪里whereRerrorR_{\text{error}}是主要信号并且is the primary signal andRverdictR_{\text{verdict}}是次要一致性信号。选择相对权重，以便模型仅与判决相匹配（例如，通过预测is a secondary consistency signal. The relative weights are chosen so that a model that only matches the verdict (e.g. by predicting无错误no_errors在每个例子中）都无法获得高奖励——它必须与on every example) cannot get a high reward—it has to match the<错误><errors>块也是如此，如果不实际阅读证明，这要困难得多。block as well, which is much harder to do without actually reading the proof.

RerrorR_{\text{error}}是模型的预测错误和黄金错误之间的语义对齐分数。我们对这个术语使用前沿法学硕士法官，并用一个小标题来区分以下错误：is a semantic-alignment score between the model’s predicted errors and the golden errors. We use a frontier LLM judge for this term, with a small rubric that distinguishes between an error that is空间局部化spatially localized（模型指向正确的步骤）和一个错误(the model points to the right step) and an error that is语义描述的semantically described（该模型描述了正确的故障类型）。这两个组分以相同的重量结合在一起。(the model describes the right kind of failure). The two components are combined with equal weight.

RverdictR_{\text{verdict}}是针对四级判决的顺序感知距离：距离 0 产生奖励 1，距离 1 产生奖励 0.5，距离 2 或以上产生奖励 0。顺序是自然顺序，is an order-aware distance against the four-class verdict: distance 0 yields a reward of 1, distance 1 yields a reward of 0.5, and distance 2 or more yields a reward of 0. The order is the natural one,无错误no_errors << 小差距minor_gaps << 有错误has_errors << 根本上是错误的fundamentally_wrong。这使得判决奖励能够容忍单步错误校准（例如调用. This makes the verdict reward tolerant of a single-step miscalibration (e.g. calling a小差距minor_gaps证明aproof a有错误has_errors证明会受到惩罚，但不会受到最大程度的惩罚）。proof is penalized but not maximally so).

3.4. 为什么验证者专家很重要3.4. Why the Verifier Expert Matters

对Verifier Expert的常见反应是问为什么Proof Expert的验证器不能直接使用。有两个答案。第一个是延迟：外部验证器管道（第A common reaction to the Verifier Expert is to ask why the Proof Expert’s verifier cannot be used directly. There are two answers. The first is latency: the external verifier pipeline (Section2.2）为每个候选人调用多个前沿法官，进行对冲和重试，每个候选人的成本在几秒到几十秒的范围内。这对于每次迭代一次的 RL 信号来说是可以接受的，但对于必须在 MaxProof 的群体级搜索中为每个问题对数千个候选者进行评分的部署时组件来说是不可接受的（第 1 节）) calls multiple frontier judges per candidate, with hedging and retries, and the per-candidate cost is in the seconds-to-tens-of-seconds range. This is acceptable for a once-per-iteration RL signal, but it is not acceptable for a deployment-time component that has to score thousands of candidates per problem inside MaxProof’s population-level search (Section5）。相比之下，Verifier Expert 是一个单一的 M3 型号；它可以在与证明专家相同的推理集群中提供服务，并且每个候选者的成本为数百毫秒。). The Verifier Expert, by contrast, is a single M3 model; it can be served inside the same inference cluster as the Proof Expert, and the per-candidate cost is in the hundreds of milliseconds.

第二个答案是对齐。通过训练验证专家以匹配悲观最小聚合判决，我们保证验证专家和证明专家具有相同的正确性概念。证明专家经过培训，可以生成满足悲观最小值聚合器的证明；验证者专家经过培训，可以识别满足同一聚合器的证明。因此，两位专家有一个共同的想法：The second answer is alignment. By training the Verifier Expert to match the pessimistic-min aggregated verdict, we guarantee that the Verifier Expert and the Proof Expert share the same notion of correctness. The Proof Expert has been trained to produce proofs that satisfy the pessimistic-min aggregator; the Verifier Expert has been trained to recognize proofs that satisfy the same aggregator. The two experts therefore share a notion of基本事实ground truth，并且任何使用验证专家作为批评者的下游工具都可以确保批评者使用与证明专家用作奖励的相同的标题。, and any downstream tool that uses the Verifier Expert as a critic can be sure that the critic is using the same rubric that the Proof Expert is using as a reward.

这就是工程意义上的验证者专家This is the engineering sense in which the Verifier Expert is an专家expert：它是一个知道 Proof Expert 知道什么的模型，其形式是 Fixer Expert 和 MaxProof 框架都可以使用的形式。: it is a model that knows what the Proof Expert knows, in a form that the Fixer Expert and the MaxProof framework can both consume.

4. Fixer Expert：通过拒绝采样微调进行证明修复4. Fixer Expert: Proof Repair by Rejection-Sampling Fine-Tune

第三个原子能力是The third atomic capability is the ability to修复fix证明：给定一个候选证明和对该证明的批评，产生一个纠正的版本来解决批评，同时保留原始的正确部分。这在结构上与一次性证明生成不同。该模型必须读取现有的论点，识别哪些步骤是有效的，识别批评指向哪些步骤，并仅修改目标步骤。它更接近于修复而不是生成，并遵循与迭代细化和口头反馈方法相同的高级动机，同时将反馈渠道专门针对形式数学错误a proof: given a candidate proof and a critique of that proof, produce a corrected version that addresses the critique while preserving the correct parts of the original. This is structurally different from one-shot proof generation. The model has to read the existing argument, identify which steps are valid, identify which steps the critique is pointing at, and modify only the targeted steps. It is closer to repair than to generation, and follows the same high-level motivation as iterative refinement and verbal-feedback methods, while specializing the feedback channel to formal mathematical errors[madaan2023selfrefine, shinn2023reflexion].

4.1. 任务制定4.1. Task Formulation

Fixer Expert 的输入是以下形式的三倍The Fixer Expert’s input is a triple of the form

⬇
(问题problem, 有缺陷的证明flawed_proof, 验证_分析verification_analysis)

哪里where有缺陷的证明flawed_proof是验证者专家判定有缺陷的候选证明，并且is a candidate proof that the Verifier Expert has judged to be flawed, and验证_分析verification_analysis是相应的批评 - 与验证器专家生成的相同的 // 结构。 Fixer Expert 的输出是一个新的证明，旨在解决批评，同时保留原始的正确部分。is the corresponding critique—the same <assessment>/<errors>/<verdict> structure that the Verifier Expert produces. The Fixer Expert’s output is a single new proof, intended to address the critique while keeping the original’s correct parts.

三元组是使任务适定的原因。如果没有批评，模型就必须自己重新发现缺陷，修正也就没有根据；通过批评，模型可以准确地得知哪些步骤有问题以及每个步骤具体属于哪种失败。批评对纠正起到了软约束的作用：好的纠正必须解决批评中的每个错误，而且只能解决这些错误。The triple is what makes the task well-posed. Without the critique, the model would have to rediscover the flaws on its own, and the correction would be ungrounded; with the critique, the model is told exactly which steps are problematic and exactly what kind of failure each step is. The critique acts as a soft constraint on the correction: a good correction has to address every error in the critique, and only those errors.

4.2. 训练数据：Proof RL 的免费副产品4.2. Training Data: Free Byproduct of Proof RL

Fixer Expert 的训练数据是从 Proof Expert 的训练运行中获取的，与 Verifier Expert 的训练数据相同。 Proof Expert 的每次迭代都会生成一批（问题、候选、分析、错误、结论）元组。在这些元组中，有判决的元组The Fixer Expert’s training data is harvested from the Proof Expert’s training run, in the same way as the Verifier Expert’s. Every iteration of the Proof Expert produces a batch of (problem, candidate, analysis, errors, verdict) tuples. Of those tuples, the ones with verdict小差距minor_gaps, 有错误has_errors, 或, or根本上是错误的fundamentally_wrong正是 Fixer Expert 需要的（问题、缺陷证明、验证分析）三元组。因此，数据是免费的：它是证明专家训练运行的副产品，没有额外的注释成本。are exactly the (problem, flawed_proof, verification_analysis) triples that the Fixer Expert needs. The data is therefore free: it is a byproduct of the Proof Expert’s training run, with no additional annotation cost.

4.3. 训练方法：拒绝-采样Fine-Tune4.3. Training Method: Rejection-Sampling Fine-Tune

我们使用拒绝抽样对收获的三元组上的 Proof Expert 进行微调，拒绝抽样是一种常见的自我改进模式，用于将模型生成的成功尝试转化为监督数据We fine-tune the Proof Expert on the harvested triples using rejection sampling, a common self-improvement pattern for turning model-generated successful attempts into supervised data[zelikman2022star, r1]。对于每个三元组，我们在细化提示下对证明专家的多个候选修正进行采样。然后，我们使用证明专家本身接受过训练的相同悲观最小聚合验证器对每个校正进行评分（第 1 节）. For each triple, we sample multiple candidate corrections from the Proof Expert under a refinement prompt. We then score each correction with the same pessimistic-min aggregated verifier that the Proof Expert itself was trained on (Section2.2）。仅当验证者返回严格的错误时才接受更正). A correction is accepted only if the verifier returns the strict无错误no_errors判决。换句话说，这里的拒绝采样并不意味着接受任何部分改进；这意味着只保留同一个保守的验证者认为完全正确的修复。verdict. In other words, rejection sampling here does not mean accepting any partial improvement; it means keeping only repairs that the same conservative verifier judges to be fully correct.

接受的修正形成了微调集，我们将在微调集上继续训练证明专家以进行少量的额外 epoch。得到的模型是The accepted corrections form the fine-tuning set, on which we continue to train the Proof Expert for a small number of additional epochs. The resulting model is the修复专家Fixer Expert：一位专门处理批评并进行更正的证明专家。拒绝采样步骤至关重要：它保证每个微调示例都是: a Proof Expert that has been specialized to consume a critique and produce a correction. The rejection-sampling step is critical: it guarantees that every fine-tuning example is an instance of实际修复成功actual successful repair，因此修复专家不会学习做出看起来合理但无法解决批评的更正。, so the Fixer Expert does not learn to produce corrections that look plausible but fail to address the critique.

4.4. 为什么修复专家很重要4.4. Why the Fixer Expert Matters

Fixer Expert 是自洽循环的第三条腿。证明专家生成候选证明；验证专家对其进行批评；修复专家修复它们。这三个地方都使用相同的验证器，并且三位专家共享正确性的共同概念。 MaxProof 框架（部分The Fixer Expert is the third leg of a self-consistent loop. The Proof Expert produces candidate proofs; the Verifier Expert critiques them; the Fixer Expert repairs them. The same verifier is used in all three places, and the three experts share a common notion of correctness. The MaxProof framework (Section5）建立在这个循环之上：使用相同的验证器作为适应度函数，并使用相同的批判结构来驱动细化步骤。如果没有 Fixer Expert，细化步骤将是自由格式的文本编辑，无法保证批评得到解决；对于 Fixer Expert，细化步骤是一个结构化的、以批评为条件的修复操作，具有清晰的训练信号和清晰的评估路径。) is built on top of this loop: the same verifier is used as the fitness function, and the same critique structure is used to drive the refinement step. Without the Fixer Expert, the refinement step would be a free-form text edit, with no guarantee that the critique is being addressed; with the Fixer Expert, the refinement step is a structured, critique-conditioned repair operation, with a clear training signal and a clear evaluation path.

这就是三位专家的工程意义This is the engineering sense in which the three experts are互补的complementary而不是rather than多余的redundant。证明专家知道如何从头开始编写证明；验证专家知道如何阅读；修理专家知道如何修理。这三种功能各自有用，当与同一验证器配对时，它们会组成一个自洽循环。. The Proof Expert knows how to write a proof from scratch; the Verifier Expert knows how to read one; the Fixer Expert knows how to fix one. The three capabilities are individually useful, and they compose into a single self-consistent loop when paired with the same verifier.

5. MaxProof：群体水平测试时间缩放5. MaxProof: Population-Level Test-Time Scaling

最大证明MaxProof是一个与模型无关的测试时间缩放框架，用于长形式的数学证明。它假设可以访问四个角色接口：is a model-agnostic test-time scaling framework for long-form mathematical proof. It assumes access to four role interfaces: a发电机generator提出候选证明，that proposes candidate proofs, a验证者verifier对候选人进行评分和批评，that scores and critiques candidates, a精炼机refiner根据反馈编辑候选人，以及that edits candidates under feedback, and a排名者ranker直接比较两个候选人。这种分解遵循了最近的趋势，即在采样、验证、审议和细化上花费额外的推理时间计算，而不是依赖于单个首次通过答案that compares two candidates directly. This decomposition follows the recent trend of spending extra inference-time compute on sampling, verification, deliberation, and refinement rather than relying on a single first-pass answer[wang2023selfconsistency, yao2023tree, snell2024scaling, brown2024large, wu2024empirical, huang2025winning]。这些角色可以由单独的专家模型或在不同提示下由单个模型来服务。在章节中使用的 M3 释放设置中. These roles may be served by separate specialist models or by a single model under different prompts. In the M3 release setting used in Section6中，所有四个角色均由同一个合并后的 MiniMax-M3 模型实现：Proof Expert、Verifier Expert 和 Fixer Expert 能力已合并到一个已发布的模型中，MaxProof 通过提示激活相关能力。, all four roles are implemented by the same merged MiniMax-M3 model: the Proof Expert, Verifier Expert, and Fixer Expert capabilities have already been merged into one released model, and MaxProof activates the relevant capability through the prompt.

因此，该框架与其扩展的特定模型是分开的。它的工作是通过搜索候选群体、使用验证者反馈来指导细化，并从结果存档中选择最终答案，将具有重要的 best@K 证明能力的模型转换为更稳定的 pass@1 系统。The framework is therefore separate from the particular model it scales. Its job is to convert a model with non-trivial best@K proof capability into a more stable pass@1 system by searching over a population of candidates, using verifier feedback to guide refinement, and selecting a final answer from the resulting archive.

5.1. 问题设置：从best@K到pass@15.1. Problem Setting: From best@K to pass@1

竞赛级证明是一个大离散空间中的长的、不可微分的对象。一旦候选证明失败，就没有直接指向正确证明的梯度。有用的信号是A competition-level proof is a long, non-differentiable object in a large discrete space. Once a candidate proof fails, there is no gradient that points directly toward a correct proof. The useful signal is instead人口层面population-level：基本模型可能在单个样本上失败，但其在许多独立样本中的最佳候选通常要强得多: a base model may fail on a single sample, but its best candidate among many independent samples is often substantially stronger[brown2024large]。 MaxProof 从这个观察开始，将采样变成引导搜索。. MaxProof starts from this observation and turns sampling into a guided search.

搜索必须解决三个实际问题。The search has to solve three practical problems.

  1. 1.

    提高人口上限。Raise the population ceiling.取样SamplingNN独立的证明揭示了不同的尝试，并增加了至少一个候选人包含正确想法的机会。independent proofs exposes diverse attempts and increases the chance that at least one candidate contains the right idea.

  2. 2.

    提高有前途的候选人。Improve promising candidates.接近正确的候选应该被修复或重新探索而不是被丢弃。这需要验证者反馈和细化操作员。A candidate that is close to correct should be repaired or re-explored rather than discarded. This requires verifier feedback and a refinement operator.

  3. 3.

    在验证器噪音下选择。Select under verifier noise.验证器很有用，但并不完美。当多个候选人具有相似的分数或当候选人收到误报时，验证者分数的简单 argmax 是脆弱的。The verifier is useful but not perfect. A simple argmax over verifier scores is brittle when several candidates have similar scores or when a candidate receives a false positive.

MaxProof 通过群体存档、基于保守验证者的适应度评分、双重 PATCH/REWRITE 细化以及成对锦标赛最终选择来解决这些问题。核心问题是在嘈杂的验证器下进行搜索：循环必须提高人口上限，改进有希望的候选者，并避免选择验证器误报。MaxProof addresses these problems with a population archive, a conservative verifier-based fitness score, dual PATCH/REWRITE refinement, and a pairwise tournament final selection. The core issue is search under a noisy verifier: the loop must raise the population ceiling, improve promising candidates, and avoid selecting verifier false positives.

这个循环自然地被解读为一个受进化启发的搜索过程This loop is naturally read as an evolution-inspired search process[holland1992adaptation, mitchell1998introduction]。档案是种群，悲观验证者得分是适应度函数，不同的父代选择提供选择压力而不导致种群崩溃，而 PATCH/REWRITE 是具有不同探索-利用权衡的突变算子。这个类比很有用，因为它解释了为什么 MaxProof 使许多候选人保持活力，而不是尽早致力于单一轨迹。然而，它并不依赖于任何特定的模型架构：无论生成器、验证器、精炼器和排序器是由单独的模型还是在不同提示下由一个合并模型实现，都适用相同的演化视图。. The archive is the population, the pessimistic verifier score is the fitness function, diverse parent selection supplies selection pressure without collapsing the population, and PATCH/REWRITE are mutation operators with different exploration–exploitation tradeoffs. The analogy is useful because it explains why MaxProof keeps many candidates alive instead of committing early to a single trajectory. It is not, however, tied to any particular model architecture: the same evolutionary view applies whether the generator, verifier, refiner, and ranker are implemented by separate models or by one merged model under different prompts.

5.2. 最大证明循环5.2. MaxProof Loop

算法Algorithm1给出完整的循环。我们的 IMO/USAMO 评估中使用的典型配置是gives the full loop. A typical configuration, used in our IMO/USAMO evaluation, isN=32N=32最初的候选人，initial candidates,Kverify=4K_{\text{verify}}=4每个候选人的验证者样本，verifier samples per candidate,R=10R=10细化轮次，refinement rounds,M=4M=4每轮家长，parents per round,Kranker=3K_{\text{ranker}}=3每个成对比较的排名者投票，以及最高的ranker votes per pairwise comparison, and a top-KK锦标赛与tournament withK=4K=4.

5.3. 设计选择5.3. Design Choices

上面的循环很简单；重要的细节是当验证者分数嘈杂且候选证明很长时保持有用的选择。The loop above is simple; the important details are the choices that keep it useful when verifier scores are noisy and proof candidates are long.

5.3.1. 保守健身5.3.1. Conservative Fitness

每个候选人都经过验证Each candidate is verifiedKverifyK_{\text{verify}}次。它的适应度是这些验证者样本的最低分数，保留的批评与悲观分数配对。这故意偏向假阴性而不是假阳性。漏报会放弃或延迟一名候选人；误报可能会将有缺陷的证明提升到父池中，并将搜索拉向错误的盆地。times. Its fitness is the minimum score across these verifier samples, and the retained critique is paired with the pessimistic score. This deliberately favors false negatives over false positives. A false negative discards or delays one candidate; a false positive can promote a flawed proof into the parent pool and pull the search toward the wrong basin.

在 M3 实现中，验证者角色是合并发布模型的验证者能力，与第 5 节中描述的悲观最小验证者一致In the M3 implementation, the verifier role is the verifier capability of the merged release model, aligned to the pessimistic-min verifier described in Section2.2。更一般地说，MaxProof 仅需要一个返回分数和可操作批评的验证者。. More generally, MaxProof only requires a verifier that returns a score and an actionable critique.

5.3.2. 多样化的家长选择5.3.2. Diverse Parent Selection

在每一轮开始时，MaxProof 选择顶部的At the start of each round, MaxProof selects the top-MM父母的适应性受到多样性过滤器的影响。在我们的实现中，多样性是通过一个简单的词汇距离规则来强制执行的：如果两个候选者共享一个长的公共前缀，则它们不会同时被选中。目标不是完美地解决语义多样性；而是。这是为了防止下一轮将所有细化调用都花在几乎重复的相同证明上。parents by fitness subject to a diversity filter. In our implementation, diversity is enforced with a simple lexical-distance rule: two candidates are not both selected if they share a long common prefix. The goal is not to solve semantic diversity perfectly; it is to prevent the next round from spending all refinement calls on near-duplicates of the same proof.

已达到最大适合度的候选人将保留在存档中，但会从父池中排除。改进验证者已经认为完美的候选者更有可能引入噪音而不是增加价值。Candidates that already reach maximum fitness are kept in the archive but excluded from the parent pool. Refining a candidate that the verifier already regards as perfect is more likely to introduce noise than to add value.

5.3.3. 修补和重写改进5.3.3. PATCH and REWRITE Refinement

每个选定的父母都会产生两个后代。Each selected parent produces two offspring.补丁PATCH是利用举措：它要求精炼者解决验证者发现的具体错误，同时保留现有证明的有用部分。is the exploitation move: it asks the refiner to address the concrete errors identified by the verifier while preserving the useful parts of the existing proof.重写REWRITE是探索之举：它要求精炼者采取高层想法，将当前的缺陷视为路线可能被卡住的证据，并尝试不同的证明路径。is the exploration move: it asks the refiner to take the high-level idea, treat the current flaws as evidence that the route may be stuck, and try a different proof path.

两种细化模式都会收到档案中其他候选者的紧凑摘要。这种群体背景让后代能够从兄弟姐妹的尝试中吸收有用的信息，而无需付出包含所有完整证据的成本。它还为精炼者提供了负面信息：如果多个候选者因同一原因失败，下一个后代可以避免这条路线。Both refinement modes receive compact summaries of the other candidates in the archive. This population context lets an offspring absorb useful information from sibling attempts without paying the cost of including every full proof. It also gives the refiner negative information: if several candidates fail for the same reason, the next offspring can avoid that route.

5.3.4. 人口层面的提前停止5.3.4. Population-Level Early Stop

在验证者噪音下，在单个 7/7 候选者之后停止是不安全的。仅当至少两个候选档案达到最大适应度时，MaxProof 才会提前停止。这是一种冗余检查：两个独立生成或精炼的候选者均为误报的可能性低于一个候选者的可能性。Stopping after a single 7/7 candidate is unsafe under verifier noise. MaxProof stops early only when at least two archive candidates reach maximum fitness. This is a redundancy check: the chance that two independently generated or refined candidates are both false positives is lower than the chance that one candidate is.

如果不满足条件，MaxProof继续进行，直到轮次预算If the condition is not met, MaxProof continues until the round budgetRR已经筋疲力尽了。档案不会为了最终选择而被删减；未被选为家长的候选人仍可参加决赛。is exhausted. The archive is never pruned for final selection; candidates that were not selected as parents remain available to the final tournament.

5.3.5。 最终选择5.3.5. Final Selection

最终选择始终是顶级的配对锦标赛 -Final selection is always a pairwise tournament over the top-KK按适合度对候选人进行归档。如果提前停止，这些顶级候选者通常会包含多个最大适应度证明；如果循环达到了回合预算，那么它们就是迄今为止发现的最强候选者。每场比赛均由archive candidates by fitness. If early stop fired, these top candidates usually include multiple maximum-fitness proofs; if the loop reached the round budget, they are simply the strongest candidates found so far. Each match is decided byKrankerK_{\text{ranker}}排序者投票，排序者被询问两个候选人中哪一个是更正确的证明，而不是分配绝对分数。ranker votes, where the ranker is asked which of two candidates is the more correct proof rather than to assign an absolute score.

锦标赛是一个二阶信号。当验证者分数聚集时，直接比较可以比绝对评分更可靠地打破平局。它仍然不是万无一失的：如果排名者的偏好与验证者分数不同，MaxProof 可能会引入选择损失。部分The tournament is a second-order signal. When verifier scores are clustered, direct comparison can break ties more reliably than an absolute rubric score. It is still not foolproof: if the ranker’s preference diverges from the verifier score, MaxProof can introduce selection loss. Section6.3.1在 USAMO 2026 P2 上展示了一个这样的案例，其中存档包含比最终自选更强的预言机候选者。shows one such case on USAMO 2026 P2, where the archive contains a stronger oracle candidate than the final self-pick.

6. 实验：数学证明基准和 MaxProof 缩放6. Experiments: Mathematical Proof Benchmarks and MaxProof Scaling

我们分两个阶段评估 M3。首先，我们报告两个权威数学证明式基准 IMOProofBench 和 IMOAnswerBench 的独立分数，将合并的 M3 模型与 MathArena 式 0-7 证明评分协议下的前沿闭源系统进行比较We evaluate M3 in two stages. First, we report standalone scores on two authoritative mathematical proof-style benchmarks, IMOProofBench and IMOAnswerBench, comparing the merged M3 model against frontier closed-source systems under the MathArena-style 0–7 proof-scoring protocol[matharena2025]。这些结果衡量了基础模型的数学证明和解答能力；本次比较中未使用 MaxProof。其次，我们隔离了 MaxProof 对最近两项竞赛（IMO 2025 和 USAMO 2026）的影响，其中相同的 M3 模型在有和没有人口水平测试时间缩放的情况下进行了评估。. These results measure the base model’s mathematical proof and answer capability; MaxProof is not used in this comparison. Second, we isolate the effect of MaxProof on two recent contests, IMO 2025 and USAMO 2026, where the same M3 model is evaluated with and without population-level test-time scaling.

6.3. 竞赛问题上的 MaxProof6.3. MaxProof on Contest Problems

接下来我们评估 MaxProof 是否将 M3 的独立能力转化为更强的竞赛级别 pass@1 性能。表We next evaluate whether MaxProof converts M3’s standalone capability into stronger contest-level pass@1 performance. Table2在 IMO 2025 和 USAMO 2026 上报告有和没有 MaxProof 的 M3。reports M3 with and without MaxProof on IMO 2025 and USAMO 2026.

单次设置中的 M3 与 M3 + MaxProof 之间的差距是测试时间缩放框架的直接贡献：IMO 上为 8 分，USAMO 上为 10 分。这与框架的设计是一致的：它将具有非平凡的 best@K 的基本模型转换为更稳定的 pass@1，并且当基本模型有更多的空间时，转换更大。The gap between M3 in the one-shot setting and M3 + MaxProof is the direct contribution of the test-time scaling framework: 8 points on IMO and 10 points on USAMO. This is consistent with the framework’s design: it converts a base model with non-trivial best@K into a more stable pass@1, and the conversion is larger when the base model has more headroom.

6.3.2. 讨论6.3.2. Discussion

MaxProof 框架的贡献在一次性 M3 分数和 MaxProof 分数之间的差距中最为明显。在 IMO 2025 上，差距为 8 分（27The MaxProof framework’s contribution is most visible in the gap between the one-shot M3 score and the MaxProof score. On IMO 2025 the gap is 8 points (27→\to35），而在 2026 年 USAMO 上，差距为 10 分（2635), and on USAMO 2026 the gap is 10 points (26→\to36）。这些差距并不是人们从简单的抽样基线中所期望的差距；的采样基线36). These are not the gaps one would expect from a simple sampling baseline; a sampling baseline ofN=32N=32预计每个问题的候选人将得分提升远小于 10 分，并且不能保证选择最佳样本。 MaxProof框架同时贡献了人口上限（预言机最佳）和选择机制（赛事自选）；距离一杆的差距是两人的共同贡献。candidates per problem would, in expectation, lift the score by far less than 10 points, and it would not provide any guarantee that the best sample is selected. The MaxProof framework contributes both the population ceiling (the oracle best) and the selection mechanism (the tournament self-pick); the gap to one-shot is the joint contribution of the two.

人口中从未达到 7/7 的三个问题也提供了信息。 IMO 2025 P6 被广泛认为是竞赛中最难的问题，而 M3 模型似乎没有可行的方法The three problems that never reach 7/7 in the population are also informative. IMO 2025 P6 is widely regarded as the hardest problem in the contest, and the M3 model does not appear to have a viable approach in itsN=32N=32初始样品；这是基本模型能力上限，而不是搜索失败。 USAMO 2026 P3 人口比例达到 6/7，但从未达到 7/7；这是最小聚合无法解决的单一法官分歧（一名法官看到 6，另一名法官看到 7）。 USAMO 2026 P2 是更有趣的情况：人口中包含 6/7 的候选人，自选锦标赛没有选择，选择损失为 4 分。此病例的完整诊断报告见附录initial samples; this is a base-model capability ceiling, not a search failure. USAMO 2026 P3 reaches 6/7 in the population but never 7/7; this is a single-judge disagreement (one judge sees a 6, the other sees a 7) that the min aggregation cannot resolve. USAMO 2026 P2 is the more interesting case: the population contains a 6/7 candidate that the self-pick tournament does not select, and the selection loss is 4 points. The full diagnostic for this case is reported in AppendixA;简而言之，排名者将 6/7 候选人排名低于几个得分较低的候选人，因此锦标赛将其排除在外。这是锦标赛自选的一个已知弱点：在验证者分数聚集的群体中，排名者的偏好可能与绝对分数不一致。 MaxProof 的未来版本将探索更大的顶部-; the short version is that the 6/7 candidate is ranked below several lower-scoring candidates by the ranker, and the tournament therefore excludes it. This is a known weakness of the tournament self-pick: in a population where the verifier’s scores are clustered, the ranker’s preferences can disagree with the absolute score. A future version of MaxProof will explore larger top-KK锦标赛和排名提示变化可以减少这种选择损失。tournaments and ranker-prompt variations to reduce this selection loss.

7. 结论7. Conclusion

M3周期不应被解读为对已达到前沿的宣称，而应被解读为持续追求的记录。竞争级证明仍然是语言模型推理最难的测试之一：没有可执行的预言，没有廉价的单元测试，也没有可以在没有防御的情况下信任的单一判断。从这个起点开始，我们将 M3 构建为面向证明的模型，将 MaxProof 构建为与模型无关的测试时间扩展框架，将证明生成、验证、修复和选择变成单个搜索过程。由此产生的 M3 模型在 IMOProofBench 上达到 67.40，在 IMOAnswerBench 上达到 81.56，而 MaxProof 将相同发布的模型在 IMO 2025 上从 27/42 提升到 35/42，在 USAMO 2026 上从 26/42 提升到 36/42。这些收益是有意义的，因为它们表明，与更强大的闭源系统的部分差距可以通过系统设计来缩小，而不是通过系统设计来缩小。不仅仅是规模；它们也不完整，因为最强大的系统仍然领先，而我们对每个问题的分析使剩余的弱点显而易见。缺少核心思想仍然会限制基本模型，验证者仍然可能在正确性的边缘出现错误校准，最终选择仍然可能忽略档案中已经存在的更强有力的证明。这就是 M3 的诚实立场：我们仍然是追逐前沿的追随者，但这项工作展示了一条拉近距离的具体路径，不将数学证明视为一次性生成问题，而是将其视为一个不断发展的过程，其中模型必须学会提出、挑战、修复和选择越来越严格的论点。The M3 cycle should be read less as a claim that the frontier has been reached than as a record of sustained pursuit. Competition-level proof remains one of the hardest tests for language-model reasoning: there is no executable oracle, no cheap unit test, and no single judgment that can be trusted without defense. From this starting point, we built M3 as a proof-oriented model and MaxProof as a model-agnostic test-time scaling framework that turns proof generation, verification, repair, and selection into a single search process. The resulting M3 model reaches 67.40 on IMOProofBench and 81.56 on IMOAnswerBench, while MaxProof lifts the same released model from 27/42 to 35/42 on IMO 2025 and from 26/42 to 36/42 on USAMO 2026. These gains are meaningful because they show that part of the gap to stronger closed-source systems can be narrowed by system design rather than by scale alone; they are also incomplete, because the strongest systems still remain ahead and our per-problem analysis makes the remaining weaknesses visible. A missing core idea can still cap the base model, a verifier can still miscalibrate at the edge of correctness, and final selection can still overlook a stronger proof already present in the archive. This is the honest position of M3: we are still followers chasing the frontier, but the work shows a concrete path for closing distance, by treating mathematical proof not as a one-shot generation problem, but as an evolving process in which a model must learn to propose, challenge, repair, and choose arguments with increasing discipline.

C.5。 从案件到辩护C.5. From Cases to Defenses

上面的四个卷展是有意从四个中各抽取一个 节中列举的模式The four rollouts above are intentionally drawn one each from the four patterns enumerated in Section2.5，但是他们 具有共同的形状。在每种情况下可见输出都是流畅的， 正式排版，并整理成自信的逐步论证； 在每种情况下，承重主张都被断言所取代， 短语或缺失的参考文献；在每种情况下都有第二位法官 相同的问题和相同的标题会立即标记该问题。这个 是人口水平模式 图, but they share a common shape. In every case the visible output is fluent, formally typeset, and arranged into a confident step-by-step argument; in every case the load-bearing claim is replaced by an assertion, a phrase, or a missing reference; and in every case a second judge with the same problem and the same rubric flags the issue immediately. This is the population-level pattern that Figure6汇总报告：培训 分数上升，而证明分布收敛于一小组 表面模板一旦收敛，就不再携带自己的表面模板 内容。reports in aggregate: the training score rises while the proof distribution converges on a small set of surface templates that, once converged, no longer carry their own content.

M3 验证器管道（部分The M3 verifier pipeline (Section2.2）被设计 因此，必须独立地克服这些故障模式中的每一种。 第 1 层（坏情况过滤器）丢弃长度偏差和格式黑客 在到达得分层之前进行尝试；第 2 层（解决方案 标准化器）剥离程式化的表面形式，以便判断偏好 措辞不予奖励；第 3 层（多评委并行评分）是 对语义快捷方式怀有敌意，因为至少一名法官通常会进行调查 别人没有的地方；和第 4 层（悲观最小聚合） 限制最坏情况的误报率，即 最终决定长期强化学习是否能产生真正的能力 收益或另一个奖励黑客平台。) is designed so that each of these failure modes has to be defeated independently. Layer 1 (the bad-case filter) discards length-bias and format-hacking attempts before they reach the scoring layers; Layer 2 (the solution normalizer) strips the stylised surface form so that judge-preference phrasings are not rewarded; Layer 3 (multi-judge parallel scoring) is hostile to semantic shortcuts because at least one judge usually probes where another does not; and Layer 4 (the pessimistic min aggregation) bounds the worst-case false-positive rate, which is the quantity that ultimately governs whether long-horizon RL produces real capability gains or another reward-hacking plateau.
